essence: Complete burning in the mouth serves as the means by which purity is obtained.
Killing living beings for oneself without prescribed method constitutes a wrongful act.
A person of evil conduct who kills without method is reborn in animal wombs.
Responsibility for improper killing extends to preparer, offerer, eater, and eight kinds of killers.
The act of killing is threefold, distinguished by killing and binding.
